text:
Situation: Digoxin 0.25 mg/mL 2 mL injection inventory is low at Corvale East with 79 units and 6.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 199 units with 14.5 days on hand. Tablet and alternate concentration stock is adequate at both sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show digoxin is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the prior shortage was first posted 2021-06-04 and has since been resolved.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The issue is a site-level imbalance for one injection presentation. Existing P&T interchange approvals cover alternate concentrations from Sandoz Inc. and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. Covis Pharma US, Inc. (plant AZURITY) is an available source.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 6 units of digoxin 0.25 mg/mL 2 mL injection from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Place purchase order with Covis Pharma US, Inc. for additional 0.25 mg/mL 2 mL injection — requires buyer execution.
3. Use Sandoz Inc. digoxin 250 mcg/mL injection per P&T interchange approval by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2026-06-02 — requires pharmacist verification of dose and volume recalculation.
4. Use Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. digoxin 0.25 mg/mL injection per P&T interchange approval by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-09-11 — requires pharmacist verification of dose and volume recalculation.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing; supply is sufficient across the system and alternate products are approved.
